Help.Permissions: Permissions: this version runs without administrator rights and is read-only. It does not modify Windows, the registry or other programs.
Help.Privacy: Privacy: everything is processed on this PC. There is no account, no ads and no telemetry, and nothing is sent to the Internet. Exported reports replace your user name, computer name and personal paths.
Help.Statuses: "Not available": Windows did not return the value on this PC. "Not supported": this version of the tool has no reliable source for that value (for example, temperatures). "Access denied": Windows protects that value. Made-up values are never shown instead.
Help.Units: Units: memory and storage use binary units (1 GiB = 1024³ bytes; Windows shows the same value as "GB"). Memory speed in MT/s. Disk throughput in MB/s (10⁶ bytes per second).
